send.effect: stored information-only acceptance; never task admission, work, approval, wake or inference

inbox.limit: absent resolves20; exact canonical decimal1..50; resolve independently before credential await

transport.authorization: one protected employee Bearer header from trusted registry; never owner fallback or JSON identity
transport.post_content_length: one canonical decimal1..32768, exact body bytes
transport.get_content_length: absent or one exact0; no Content-Type

limits.timestamps: UTC epoch milliseconds; record/read timestamps2000inclusive..2100exclusive; Actor lease is a finite nonnegative safe integer epoch millisecond value

authority.both_participants: current registry and unrevoked Store employee principals; current synthetic admission/machine/generation; own active claimed/running project task/attempt and lease; matching task/input/binding/playbook digests, active approved staffing/project/work-order; fail closed during recovery or ambiguity
authority.payload_identity: command supplies no sender authority; task_id/attempt_id must match protected current sender; exactly one other recipient resolved by existing current registry/Store authority
authority.production_admission: synthetic_only; real protected native auth/renewal, effective model settings, trusted accounting and Maritime cloud pilot remain gates
authority.rechecks: registry guard then service FileLease then short Store transaction; current authorization before protected claim lookup/replay/read and final return; no network in transaction
authority.recorded_author_and_actor: descriptive accepted provenance only, not credential/authentication or permission proof
authority.new_lane_identifier_boundary: Before Actor emission, all principal/machine/task/work-order/attempt IDs are nonempty, non-NUL strict UTF8 <=128 bytes. Existing otherwise valid authority outside this representable frozen-reference boundary fails authority_unavailable503; underlying Store/Registry semantics are unchanged.

acceptance.atomic: exact immutable conversation binding/revision, message, delivery, canonical message.accepted event, command receipt, global principal+command claim and local_inbox outbox commit or roll back together in existing Store
acceptance.idempotency: unique stable principal_id + command_id across supported communication actions; changed normalized arguments, scope or action conflict; exact replay returns stored receipt without duplicate records or redelivery
acceptance.argument_digest: SHA-256 frozen C01 canonical UTF-8 of full validated command excluding only command_id; no extra preimage fields
acceptance.correlation: server-generated UUID once at acceptance, retained exactly on replay; no inferred causality or actor authority
acceptance.expiry: fixed min(accepted_at+900000, accepted sender lease, accepted recipient lease), never extended by replay or lease renewal; expired deliveries hidden from inbox, no new side effect
acceptance.conversation: client UUID proposes room identity only; exact immutable company/project/sender+recipient generation/task/attempt/input bindings; no silent rebinding; ordinary append no head CAS; old owner/private/foreign collisions denied
acceptance.tasks: Conversation task/work-order refs use actual IDs with revision/digest null+unavailable; no TaskSpec hash fabricated as record digest
acceptance.outbox: durable local_inbox/stored reference only; no dispatcher, consumption/ACK, employee wake, external send or task action

inbox.selection: current recipient principal/employee/machine/generation/project plus unexpired fixed delivery; actor binding compares every field except lease_until_utc_epoch_ms
inbox.order: recipient_sequence_descending; durable per-recipient principal/project/generation sequence, not global event position or timestamp causality
inbox.bounded_work: select at most resolved limit+1; validate every selected candidate including lookahead before item/encoded-byte omission; never skip selected corruption
inbox.bytes: whole newest items only; complete canonical response including escapes, Actor/context, refs and all digests <=262144 before send
inbox.coverage: observed/none means complete currently eligible query at this read; partial/item_limit or partial/byte_limit signals omitted eligible history; no totals, has_more or continuation inferred; page has no retained snapshot and may change on later independent reads
inbox.empty: authorized observed empty items differs from missing capability/authority/corruption closed503
inbox.reads: no setup/adoption, read mutation, ACK, receipt change, model request, wake or work admission

normalization.codec: unchanged frozen C01 strict UTF-8/duplicate-key/surrogate/integer-token/safe-range/UTF16 member ordering; raw command cap32768 and separate output cap262144
normalization.digest: SHA-256 canonical UTF-8 of each complete record or projection excluding only that objects own digest; nested digests remain in preimage
normalization.supplemental: structural JSON Schema alone cannot prove UTF-8 byte caps, raw limits, digests, scoped relationships, current authentication, query/limit binding, expiry/order or receipt provenance

receiver_checks: Retain independently permitted company/project, sender/task/attempt and one recipient request and command ID before credential await; never derive authorization from returned Actor, observation or principal prose.
Use strict raw JSON before validation. Commands remain32768; measure complete raw/canonical output262144. Recompute own digests excluding only own digest.

For send compare receipt command_id/action/argument_digest/company/scope to independently retained original command; argument_digest uses frozen C01 command preimage. Stored receipt proves information acceptance only.

For inbox bind requested_limit to independently resolved query limit, page company/scope and current recipient to independently permitted context. Stored accepted recipient lease can differ from current page lease; compare immutable binding excluding only lease.

Validate each Conversation/Message independently at its own historical revision, then exact full IDs/revisions/digests/company/scope refs across receipt/event/delivery/message. Never replace historical refs with head or collapse revisions in kind:id map.

Check sender/recipient snapshots, sole recipient, task/attempt/generation bindings, correlation and recorded/expiry values agree across wrapper records; fixed expiry <= accepted_at+900000 and both accepted leases; inbox eligible expiry > observed_at.

Require distinct message/delivery/event/receipt IDs and descending distinct inbox_sequence; no promise of global contiguity across expired rows or independent pages. Item count <= independently expected limit, max50.
No automatic retry, replacement IDs, compensating append, polling or continuation. Caller retains exact pending envelope for explicit same-ID recovery. Projection never executes a command or action.

implementation.sole_authority: existing Store/registry/approval/task authority, no second database/registry/scheduler
